svg.title: Fisko container view
svg.desc: Users reach the edge, which sends each request to the agency's cell. A cell holds the modular monolith, the outbox relay and adapters, with PostgreSQL, RabbitMQ, OpenSearch and file storage. Keycloak and KMS sit outside the cell, and external systems sit outside the cloud.

g.text: Thai commercial cloud: data, backups and logs stay in Thailand
